1. Create a master validation file from the first Vision export

Drop the Condition Data List Export from M3Vision (the vertical sheet: one row per UPRN × component) – and, if you have them, the Hazard List Export and the Comments Export at the same time (the page recognises each file by its columns). The condition data becomes the usual horizontal layout – one row per property, one column per question; hazards become HHSRS Issues 1–7 and comments become General Comments. Every imported row of all three files is kept on Original Data Imported, each step on the Import Log, and the builder settings inside the same workbook. Nothing is uploaded.

⬇ Drag the Vision exports here
e.g. 15a. Condition Data List Export ….xlsx (needed) plus 15b. Hazard List Export … and 15c. Comments Export … (optional) · drop one, two or all three together
📂 …or open a master you saved earlier
“…-Master Data File-V….xlsm” (or an older ….xlsx master) – brings back the grid, yellow edits, standard answers, builder settings, macros, Original Data Imported and Import Log
⬇ Or start from an existing Master Data File
.xlsm or .xlsx · this file’s columns, in this order, and its rows become the new master. Headers stay as they are. Columns you left out are not added. Saved as {Project name}-Master Data File-V1.

3. Import new Vision data into the master

Drop later Vision exports – a Condition Data List Export, a Hazard List Export, a Comments Export, or any mix of them at once (imported in that order). New properties are added as new rows. A property that is already in the master is skipped if its Vision data is identical. If the data is different, it is added as a second row right under the first with its UPRN shown pink – your validated row is never changed; compare the two with Show All Duplicates and delete the one you don’t want. Hazards and comments are added to the matching properties (an issue that arrives after the row already existed is highlighted lilac, and HHSRS Checked goes back to “No”). Every imported row is kept on the Original Data Imported sheet and each import is recorded on the Import Log sheet.

⬇ Drag the next Vision exports here
Condition rows already imported (identical) and hazards / comments with an ID already imported are skipped, so re-importing the same file is harmless.

Import data from an existing MDF

Drop a master that is already in the horizontal layout (one row per property), such as the checked pilot workbook. Columns are matched on the header name, ignoring capital letters and extra spaces. Nothing is guessed. Columns that do not match are listed so you can tick the ones you want, or leave them out. Rows are matched on UPRN: values from this file replace the master, and properties that are not already there are added. A sheet that does not have a saved column order yet keeps the workbook’s own header order.

⬇ Drag an existing master here
.xlsx or .xlsm · a sheet bigger than 40 MB uncompressed (for example a raw RDSAP dump) is skipped
